snippet.title: TIME BREAKING: DINO BREACH (Dino Crisis inspired game) - Teaser trailer
snippet.description:
Time Breaking: Dino Breach is an isometric survival horror adventure inspired by Dino Crisis, with which it shares modernized gameplay and graphics, but still able to breathe that old-school atmosphere typical of those games.

The story centers on the inevitability of fate and the desperate attempt of a woman who, in order to save a loved one, begins to travel through time, confronting dangerous dinosaurs and causing irreparable damage in space-time that will endanger all of humanity, leading her to face the consequences of her actions.

The Time Breaking: Dino Breach page is now available on Steam. You can add it to your wishlist ❤, demo will also be available soon!🦖

STEAM LINK: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3407680/Time_Breaking_Dino_Breach/?fbclid=PAZXh0bgNhZW0CMTEAAabzUnHh5CwgtSkGG2aH-RqOEbX5Vg4GnSKLdSoVJcZLUF3qGamlJPlEpSM_aem_kKRn3M5fwtBcM_4WgHQhYQ
